nodes.subject: Science
nodes.title: Define agricultural crops
nodes.outcome: Define a crop as a plant of the same kind cultivated on a large scale for food or other products.

nodes.subject: Science
nodes.title: Classify Kharif and Rabi
nodes.outcome: Classify crops into Kharif and Rabi categories based on the specific seasons of sowing.

nodes.subject: Science
nodes.title: List agricultural practices
nodes.outcome: List the seven basic agricultural practices in their chronological order of execution.

nodes.subject: Science
nodes.title: Explain crop seasonality
nodes.outcome: Explain why certain crops cannot be grown in winter due to specific climatic requirements.

nodes.subject: Science
nodes.title: Explain soil loosening benefits
nodes.outcome: Explain why loosening soil is necessary for root respiration, water absorption, and earthworm survival.

nodes.subject: Science
nodes.title: Identify soil implements
nodes.outcome: Identify diagrams of a plough, hoe, and tractor-driven cultivator used in soil preparation.

nodes.subject: Science
nodes.title: Perform seed flotation test
nodes.outcome: Explain the water flotation method to distinguish healthy seeds from damaged ones.

nodes.subject: Science
nodes.title: Compare sowing methods
nodes.outcome: Compare the traditional funnel tool with the modern seed drill regarding spacing, depth, and bird protection.

nodes.subject: Science
nodes.title: Differentiate manure and fertilizer
nodes.outcome: Define manure and fertilizers and list three differences between them.

nodes.subject: Science
nodes.title: Explain crop rotation
nodes.outcome: Explain the process of crop rotation and how it naturally replenishes soil nitrogen levels.

nodes.subject: Science
nodes.title: Define irrigation
nodes.outcome: Define irrigation and explain the necessity of a continuous water supply for crop survival.

nodes.subject: Science
nodes.title: Describe modern irrigation
nodes.outcome: Describe the operating mechanisms of modern water-saving sprinkler and drip irrigation systems.

nodes.subject: Science
nodes.title: Explain weed impact
nodes.outcome: Explain why weeds compete with crop plants for light, space, and soil nutrients.

nodes.subject: Science
nodes.title: List weeding methods
nodes.outcome: List methods of weeding including manual removal, tilling, and the application of chemical weedicides.

nodes.subject: Science
nodes.title: Define harvest processes
nodes.outcome: Define harvesting, threshing, and winnowing in the context of cereal grain preparation.

nodes.subject: Science
nodes.title: Describe combine harvester
nodes.outcome: Identify the dual role of a 'Combine' machine in simultaneously performing harvesting and threshing.

nodes.subject: Science
nodes.title: State storage precautions
nodes.outcome: State the preventive measures required before storing grains to protect them from moisture, insects, and microorganisms.

nodes.subject: Science
nodes.title: Contrast storage methods
nodes.outcome: Differentiate between domestic storage practices and large-scale storage in silos and granaries.

nodes.subject: Science
nodes.title: Define animal husbandry
nodes.outcome: Define animal husbandry as the agricultural practice of breeding and raising livestock.

nodes.subject: Science
nodes.title: List animal food products
nodes.outcome: List food products obtained from animals and identify their primary nutritional benefits.
